note: CAUTION: this is the only look in the set that deliberately raises saturation (1.18 plus vibrance 0.25), because neon signage is the one subject where colour intensity IS the look. That also makes it the riskiest to stack - the grade multiplies with the fx layer, and an over-strong grade once turned a third of a film magenta, so pair this with hot or glow sparingly and look at the render. Deep blue shadows carry the night, magenta-blue highlights carry the signage.
